_note: Draft English rendering of Saadia's JA Tafsir on Shemot 33, generated by scripts/translate_tafsir_english.py against the JA (not the biblical Hebrew). Translation goal: reverse-translatability for the Tafsir reader — readers should be able to map English back to JA. Saadia-specific moves preserved per data-source/saadia-gloss-table.json; Blau's notes (data-source/blau-genesis-notes.json) consulted for Bereshit 1-12.

translations.1: And God said to Moses: 'Go, ascend from here — you and the people whom you brought up from Egypt — to the land which I swore to Abraham and Isaac and Jacob, saying: To your offspring I shall give it.'
translations.2: And I shall send before you an angel, by whom I shall drive out the Canaanites and the Amorites, and the Hittites and the Perizzites, and the Hivites and the Jebusites —
translations.3: to a land flowing with milk and honey. For I shall not bring up My light in your midst, for you are a stiff-necked people, lest I bring you to an end along the way.'
translations.4: And when the people heard this evil report, they grieved, and no one put his distinctive attire upon himself.
translations.5: And God said to Moses: 'Say to the sons of Israel: You are a stiff-necked people. If I were to bring up My light in your midst for even a single instant, I would bring you to an end. And now — proceed to remove your distinctive attire, that I may make known to you what I shall do with you.'
translations.6: And the sons of Israel proceeded to remove their distinctive attire, from Mount Horeb.
translations.7: And Moses would take the tent and pitch it outside the camp, far from it, and call it the tent of appointment. And it was that whoever sought knowledge from God would go out to the tent of appointment which was outside the camp.
translations.8: And it was, whenever Moses went out to the tent, all the people would rise and station themselves — each man at the door of his tent — and they would look after Moses, until his entry into the tent.
translations.9: And it was, whenever Moses entered the tent, the pillar of cloud would descend and stand at the door of the tent; and God would speak with Moses.
translations.10: And whenever all the people saw the pillar of cloud standing at the door of the tent, all the people would rise together, and each man would bow down at the door of his tent.
translations.11: And God would speak with Moses mouth to mouth, as a man speaks with his companion. And he would return to the camp. And his attendant, Joshua son of Nun, a young man, would not depart from the tent.
translations.12: And Moses said to God: 'You know that You said to me: Bring up these people — and yet You have not made known to me whom You are sending with me. And You have said to me: I have honored your name, and you have found favor with Me.'
translations.13: And now — if I have found favor with You, make known to me Your way, that I may know You, so that I may find favor with You; and look upon Your people, this nation.'
translations.14: He said to him: 'My light shall go with you, until I bring you to rest.'
translations.15: He said: 'If Your light does not go with us from now, do not bring us up from here.'
translations.16: And by what shall it now be known that I — and Your people — have found favor with You, except by Your light going with us? So that we — I and Your people — may be set apart from all the peoples who are upon the face of the earth.'
translations.17: And God said to Moses: 'This thing which you have asked — I shall do as well, for you have found favor with Me, and I have honored your name.'
translations.18: He said: 'Show me Your light as well.'
translations.19: He said: 'I shall cause all My light to pass in your presence, and I shall call out in the name of God before you; and I shall show kindness to whom I show kindness, and I shall show mercy to whom I show mercy.'
translations.20: He said: 'You are not able to behold My light, for no person can behold it and live.'
translations.21: And God said: 'Behold, there is a place with Me — station yourself upon the flint.'
translations.22: 'And when My light passes by you, I shall place you in the cleft of the flint, and shall cast the shade of My cloud over you, until the first of it has passed.'
translations.23: 'Then I shall remove My cloud, so that you may behold the latter part of My light — but its beginnings you shall not behold.'
